title: NBIM urges SEC to reform shareholder proposal rule, not rescind it
lede: Sovereign wealth fund suggests regulator should consider amendments while preserving 'uniform, predictable route' to ballot.

title: [Interview] ‘There is nothing soft about Russian soft power’: Ukraine institute director on the battle to re-name streets honouring Pushkin and other Russian figures
lede: Should Russian cultural figures continue to be celebrated in European public spaces? Should streets named after Pushkin be renamed? Where do we draw the line between rejecting Russian imperialism and preserving Russian cultural heritage? These are some of the questions director general of the Ukrainian Institute Volodymyr Sheiko discusses with EUobserver.

title: From protest to power: Serbia’s student movement prepares to dismantle Vučić’s regime
lede: Serbia’s student movement has secured a historic parliamentary victory, ending Aleksandar Vučić’s 14-year grip on power. With 140 seats in the 250-seat assembly, the movement now faces the challenge of forming a government, tackling corruption and delivering domestic reforms. But its diverse political factions remain divided over Serbia’s future relationship with the EU and Russia.

title: Fighting at sea escalates sharply: Russian ships are burning in the Baltic and Mediterranean (Ukraine Battlefield update, Day 1,733)
lede: Ukrainian drones torch a prized Russian warship in Libya and a military cargo vessel in the Baltic, while commanders in Moscow and Helsinki alike are suddenly forced to rethink how close this war has come to their own shores.
